title: Asynchronous repository deletion and Git branch improvements
summary: Dataform introduces long-running repository deletion and clarifies Git default branch behavior.
details: A new method `repositories.deleteLongRunning` has been added, allowing developers to delete repositories asynchronously. This includes a `force` parameter in the `DeleteRepositoryLongRunningRequest` to automatically clean up child resources like compilation results and workflow invocations, though it notably fails if workspaces or configs still exist. Additionally, `GitRemoteSettings.defaultBranch` is now optional (defaulting to 'main'), and a new output-only `effectiveDefaultBranch` field helps identify the active branch being used by the service.
